newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers dull in post-weekend mood.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers dull in post-weekend mood.

text.p: The Singapore bunker quotes on Monday hovered around Friday's levels but weak demand amid a dull post-weekend mood may drag prices lower, traders said.
"Enquiries are not very forthcoming...maybe it is still too early in the week, but demand has been pretty thin recently," a major said.
Bunker 180-cst supplies were quoted at between $104-$107 and 380-cst at $96.50-$99 per tonne.
MDO and gas oil were quoted around $188-$190 and $200-$205 respectively.
